gloss: sense of discomfort; feeling that something is off

definitions.gloss: sense of discomfort; feeling that something is off
definitions.explanation: An uncomfortable feeling that something is not quite right, strange, or out of place.
An abnormal or uncomfortable physical sensation, often used in medical contexts.

⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{違和感|いわかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わからなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I felt that something was off, but I couldn't figure out why.

examples.english: There's something off about this sentence, but I can't explain it well.
I have discomfort in my knee.

notes:
FORMS:
{違和|いわ} (discord; dissonance) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {違和感|いわかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to feel/not feel something is off
- {違和感|いわかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense something is off
- {違和感|いわかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel a sense of wrongness
- {違和感|いわかん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without feeling out of place

USAGE:
Very commonly used to express that subtle feeling when something doesn't fit or seems unnatural, even if you can't explain why. Frequently used in:
- Translation/language discussions (unnatural wording)
- Design/aesthetics (something looks off)
- Personal relationships (something feels wrong)
- Medical symptoms (unusual physical sensation)

ANTONYM CONCEPT:
{違和感|いわかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means something feels natural or fits well.
